text: Ive really slowed down on writing and checking in with myself. I used to do it every day. I guess its about time though because Im trying to make some art and I cant come up with a single idea. Ive got my exhibit coming up in a few months and im stressing to try and have enough pieces done in time for the show. Ive been distracting myself a lot lately with weed, nicotine, and quick dopamine hits from my phone. Ive been staying up all night on my phone then sleeping all day and wondering why I feel tired all day and have no motivation. Dealing with Brice the last few weeks has been a lot. Its definitely been a nice reflection on my own situation two years ago and how much I really overreacted. It Pisses me off that I let someone have that much control over me and how I felt. Its embarrassing. Ive finally gotten to where I am okay being alone but I still find my self spending too much time thinking about how I would want to be with other people. Its out of my control. I made the choices I made. She made the choices she made. If it was meant to have gone any other way it would have. Im finally at a place where I feel pretty okay with where Im at and what Im doing. I dont know If its the meds or my own actions that led to the change. But Im not freaking out near as much as I was this time last year. Actually the amount of improvememtn Ive made just in the last year is pretty incredible. I have a bit of impositor syndrome because of it. It doednt feel like I deserve to be doing better than I was. Theres days I still beat myself up for things that were out of my control. I have worked hard to achieve what I have and reach the places I have. I have my own company now. Im on the board of 3 other ones. I have my own exhibit coming up. Im going to japan to watch my brother get married in a few months. I bought tickets to go see my favorite band in colorado. Ive got good friends around me that care about me and encourage me to do better now. Ive got people that rely on my presence and skills at work. Ive got a community that relies on me to create a shared space. Theres no reason to keep beating myself up and telling myself that Im not good enough or not worth receiving the good fortune that im experiencing. I can do this. I dont have to convince myself that Im an artists every time I sit down to make a piece. I dont even know what this process is. Of sitting down in one spot for hours trying to drag some unexplainable thing out of your soul and put in a form that can be conveyed to others. Art doesnt have to have meaning, but I like for my own art to have personal meaning to me. I take all of this so seriously. Im just saying words and taping pieces of paper together and praying that something larger than myself emerges out of it. Its silly. I spend so much time getting sucked into my phone scrolling through infinite reels. It feels like getting caught in a fly trap. Constantly dragging my attention along with me. Snagging it on every corner and ledge. I dont know what im doing. I dont think I will ever know what im doing. Everyone else seems like they are so sure, but it has to be an act. Do people really wake up in the morning and not question what is happening around them. How good of a distraction can going to work really be in the face of revelation. All I can do it point at it. I dont get art. I dont get living. What am I supposed to be doing. Yet here we are. My cat doesnt worry about this. She just wakes up and goes to sit in the window. Why do I worry.  I still have a bunch of pictures I need to make before may. Im struggling to come up with any ideas. Its always hard with the handcut collages because I have to wrk within the limitations of what I have a lot more. I cant construct the meanings I want as eaasiely. Also its winter time, everything has slowed down. I cant expect to produce how I can at my peak in the middle of february

text: Up late again. It's 5am and I should be asleep but I've been sick for the last 4 days and now I'm not tired. Why does it scare me that I can improve. Why do I want to stay addicted. Why do I want to keep myself hidden. Why can't I face being seen. None of these can be answered all at once. But I'm thinking about it. I'll go week, months, years, forgetting there's a path. Forgetting that I am a human being taking the human curriculum. Forgetting that I can take action. Forgetting that I can be aware. I numb myself down with video games, nicotine, weed abuse, masturbation, endless content consumption to distract myself from the fact that I am alive. To distract myself that I am dying. Then I have moments like these where it could not be more obvious that I am a soul in a human incarnation. That I have a body that needs to be taken care of. That I have problems that I need to deal with. That I have responsibility to myself and others that I have to uphold. Then I feel like I have to do it all at once. That I have to make up for the supposed “wasted time” like it's not all part of the path. I easily ignore how much I've changed just in the past few months. I'm hard on myself. I place expectations on myself that I'm not able to even fully define let alone ever reach. I disregard my shadow I hide it away behind a smile to hide how upset and hurt I can feel. I don't allow myself to be vulnerable even with myself let alone with the rest of the world. But then I look back and I can't be hard on myself any more. There's not much reason to. I've become a person that I can respect more. I've become a person that has the capability to respect my former self if I would allow it. But it still slips out. The work is what's in front of me. Why cling to these ideas of myself that I can no longer justify. Why not allow myself to be vulnerable and “cringe” to the people who's judgements I fear. Why not allow my voice and thoughts to be expressed and received by others. Why keep distancing myself from myself and my own abilities as a person by other using these substances. I don't know how to accomplish these things but I don't think I need to know how to. I think as long as I'm taking a step then I'm doing pretty good. I know that I don't know shit now and I definitely don't know enough to judge myself on the scale that I do. I know that I will fail. Over and over and over and over. But the never ending failures only build up the resistance of the success that I achieve. I'm doing okay. I don't need to panic that I'm not doing enough. It's okay to take a few days off. Be thankful that you are so quick to want to get back to this path again, rather than wandering around lost and hopeless for months wondering what went wrong like usual. You're here now. You are forgiven. You are human. You are growing. You are going to make mistakes. You are going to have losses. Don't assume that you know the outcomes that you need. Accept what you receive. The biggest losses have turned into some of the most important lessons. The stillness is what leads to action. Your doing fine. I love you.

text: It's been a while since I've done this. But it's 5:00am and I can't sleep because I'm full of thoughts that need to get out. A lot has changed since the last time I touched base here. text: What is it to be an artist? Can I still call myself an artist if I haven't had the drive to create a picture in months? I've only been doing it because I feel like it's something I should be doing because of the role I'm playing. I'm still creating. I still have ideas I still want to express myself. But right now nothing is coming out that I can show others. It's all in my head. It's a song I sing to myself, emotions I work through privately. It's still the same process that I used to create my pictures but now I'm creating communities and healthier relationships. But more often than not now I find myself searching for the satisfaction of creating something through my phone by looking at other people's works. This is why I wanted to keep the art separate from business. I'm the best at making art for myself. When I try to think about what other people would want to see, everything shuts off. Because that's not the reason I do this. I do this to help myself. I do this because it feels good to do and it's healthier than playing video games or scrolling through instagram. It's always terrifying starting into that white abyss of a blank page after each finished project. Every time I question if I'm really good enough to be doing this. If I really have anything to say. If I really have the skills to be able to express these thoughts or emotions through a visual form. But through that conflict somehow every time something new emerges. Something novel that I never could have predicted that changes the course of the whole idea and takes it to a new place than where I started. I'm always so caught up in the idea of the thing but the initial idea is rarely what gets conveyed through the end. The initial idea is like the emotional casting-off point. It's required to get the wheels moving but after the engine starts the car pushes itself. I'm never really too sure of what I'm doing. But I do know what I want. I want to find more people like me. Everyone is like me, everyone is. The further I go to try and find the thing I'm looking for the more lost I'm going to get. I should accept what I have now. I do, but I want people to make things with. I want people that want to grow. I want curious people, I want kind people. I don't want to let the thought that I need these people hold me back from doing what I do. But I want what I do to help lead me to that place where I want to be. I also see that the only way I am going to find those people is if I start to accept who I really am and stop trying to conform to other people's expectations or judgments of me. Too often I let other people's perceptions and thoughts about me shape who I am. But they don't matter unless I let them matter. I know who I am not. I'm starting to love myself now. I know I haven't done anything wrong just being me. I deserve love and respect because I'm a human. I don't have to try and earn it from those who are not capable of giving it to themselves let alone other people. I provide my own worth, my own confidence, my own love. I shouldn't require approval in order to exist. I am enough, I have enough, I give enough, I provide enough, I care enough .I'm doing fine. I'm my own worst enemy when it comes to this because ive built up a model of godlike perfection that is impossible for me to ever live up to. Because there is too much later, there is no growth, there is no past, I am what I am not, I have what I have now. I separate myself from myself by holding on to this story of who I am and who I should be. Give it up, surrender it. You still exist after the story drops. Your body stays, your awareness stays. The only thing that dies is your ego and the ideas that limit you and hold you back from who you really are and who you really could be. You are it. Thou art That. There's no other way you could be. You are here now. You are the creator and the creation simultaneously. There's nothing that is done and nothing that is left undone. You are okay.

text: Up and Down, this has been a crazy week. We have had shows at the arts council every day for the last five days. Its okay for me to feel a little tired to day and not be able to get everything done that I want. Its been a really good week. Ive felt really busy, ive done a ton of stuff and some how managed to make 2 pictures in the middle of all of the chaos. I should be getting some pretty good money in the next week or so too. The stuff at the Arts council is quickly turning into a full time gig. Im really happy with it and really thankful for the job. Ive had a lot of fun this last week. Ive made two pictures this week that Im super happy with. After struggling for a month to make anything these two just fell out and they are great. Im starting to get ready for art crawl and try to be a little more prepared this year than I was last year. I dont want to be rushing everything the day before hand. I got a little upset today because my friends said they would hang out but then didnt but thats fine. Its not my fault they are acting like this. Im trying to learn loving emotional detachment. I know I havent done anything to hurt them, and if I have they should care about me enough to tell me and if they dont thats not my fault. Im working to build a new community that is a little healthier. I want a new group of friends that have ambitions and want to do things. I want to find some people in statesville that feel similarly to me, there have to be more. I want to create with people and come up with new ideas. I want to lift each other up instead of competing. I want to inspire each other instead of being disappointed in ourselves. Its not your fault your friends are locking themselves away. You cant do anything to make them open up other than being open and patient. You didnt make them do this. You didnt intentionally do anything to harm anyone. You tried to help them, you tried to encourage them, you tried to be there for them, you tried to show that someone cared. Its not your fault they cant return that. Its been a year and your getting a lot better with this. Your learning where your bounds are. Your learning when your giving yourself away. Your learning when you step away. Your learning that not everything is your fault. Your learning you dont have to take the blame for ther peoples actions. You acted to the best of your ability. You made a conscious and consistent effort to be a good and honest friend. You were present, you offered what little advice you could, you tried to face the issues that arose and work through them without aggression. Its not your fault they didnt want to do the same. I dont even know why I feel the need for a partner so strongly. It seems partly evolutionary, partly subconscious, partially self destructive, partially honest love. But it doesnt seem with it to go through this thing alone. I can do that if I want to , but whats the point if I cant share any of what im doing with anyone. Why make art if im the only one to look at it. I would still make it anyways. But its so much better with the other person. Humans need humans. Im not flawed for wanting connectino. Im not flawed for wanting a space to honestly and humanly express myself. Im not flawed for wanting a group of friends with similar believes that care and support each other. Your a human. These are the things you should be striving for. The system in place tells you otherwise with everysign. But this is what my soul if dragging me towards. Ive always felt we could be doing things better. We could just care a little more. We could just be more aware of how our actions effect the whole mechanism. I want a healthy family. I want to feel like I belong. I want to feel like I matter. I want to feel like I have a place and can make substantial change to my own section of reality. Im not egotistical for wanting these things. Im not selfish for striving for growth. Im not an asshole for talking about the things im passionate about and working on. Im not a nerd for thinking about things on a grander scale and taking into scout worldly believes. Im not a hippie for believing that we could be a little more compassionate and understanding to each other in our community. Im not a liberal for not wanting to assist in spreading a message to thousands of people that black people come from the devil. Im someone that is trying their best. Theres not too many like that. Your going in the right direction. Losing friends sucks but you need to move on. You helped them the best that you could while you could. There not going anywhere for a little bit. There not dying at least. Your just not going to be around them every day like you were. Youve been through this a douzen times at this point and every time you end up in a better and better place. Dont resist the change. Dont cling onto the relationships that are holding you back and not doing anything to serve you. Definitely dont keep feeding a corpse after its already dead. Your not stopping here, you will make new friends, you will find new people. The friends you had this time were really good ones while they were around as much as they were. At least there isnt anger this time. Its a little easier to let go. Youll still be here and they will still be there. You will survive. You know you are moving on into new and better places. Just look at what is happening around you right now. You just worked 5 sold out show in a row in stateville of all places. That shit crazy. Everything is about to blow up in the best of ways. And you are righ tin the center of it. You are in just the right place in just the right time. Youve gone from being isolated, depressed, and alone. To being in the center of a community that cares about you and wants to see you grow and is helping you to build up your own offering. Your in a good place.

text: Its been a while since ive wrote, again. Im noticing that more and more time is going by inbetween moments when I touch in with myself. Ive been feeling a bit out of it again but its not as bad as it normally is. I guess I havent wrote any since I went to chicago. We had a family trip and it actually went alright. There werent any fights. I wasnt miserable the whole time. It actually went okay and there were some moments where I had a good time. But now im back in statesville and shit is already getting crazy again. Lari and garret are breaking up again and Garion is moved out now. Weve moved out of the clock tower, and ive lost some of my income. A lot has changed in the last few weeks and I think its just starting to overwhelm me some. Im not checking in with myself again and building up too much without releasing it. Ive been struggling to make art this month for some reason. I was doing pretty good last month but ive had a hard time expressing myself recently. Ive been judgemental of my own ideas and the perceived quality of them and ive been letting that hold me back from even starting. Also ive just been busy lately. There has been a lot going on. I havent had to many moments to just sit down and explore my own head and see what I feel. Ive been playing video games and watching youtube trying to ignore the fact that im stressed and tired. I see this cycle now. Adn I see how to get out of it. Its not as bad as it normally is. And I know that this feeling of being stuck is temporary. And I know that the way out of it is by doing this. Its by facing myself head on and seeing whats inside and coming to terms with it. Thats part of the reason I cant make anything. I sit down to create and theres a million things I want to say but none of them are clear enough to communicate. I feel like this last month has been very reflective. Like im being shown versions of myself in the past constantly in the people around me. Like every day feels like walking through a hall of mirrors. And at first I was okay with it and ive been learning a lot from it. But now im starting to wonder when im going to start seeing whats beyond the reflection. Im tired of watching the people care about get hurt .Im tired of watching my friends get scared and run away. Im tired of losing people. I wonder some days if it will ever stop but I know it wont. I feel bad about the way things went with Ashton but its really not my part to do much. Hes making his own choices. It was harder than I wanted to admit helping Garion move today. It was very similar to what happened when I moved out. It sucks that he wont even come out of his room to say goodbye. It sucks that he avoided everything and locked himself in his room. But were here now. It sucks watching Lari get stuck in an abusive relationship. It sucks seeing myself in her and how much I thought I needed Ashley but really I was just holding both of us back. It sucks how upset I still am over the stuff that happened over two years ago now. But I guess this is how I get over it. I learn to see it in the people I care about and accept it and learn to love it. It definitely helps me see that it wasnt me doing anything wrong. I wasnt a bad person for going what I went through .It was very human. Im seeing everyone else go through the same things. Im learning a lot of grace through this. I still think about her every day. I dont know if that will stop at this point. It changed who I am to the core. I still wish there was someone here to grow with me. I still feel alone in myself. Its getting better. Its getting easier. But whats the point of going through all this if theres noone to share it with. I miss her still. I miss having someone to share ideas with . I miss having someone to help me create. Im sure she feels the same. I still keep checking her social media to see if anything has changed. I wish I would stop doing that. Its only hurting me more. It just makes me sad to see she hasnt done anything new, and it makes me feel worse to see she is doing something without me. I told her I would be the one to reach out when I was ready. But I dont know if I can ever do that. I said I wanted to wait until the pain went away. But the pain is just pain. I can heal from it myself but I dont think when I do I would want to go back to her, So I keep ripping open this scar again and again hoping things could be different. How can you care about someone so much but tear them apart so much when you are with them. I  care about her enough to know that I cant be with her righ tnow. I care about her enough to know that staying with her would have hurt both of us. I wish I could move on. I wish I could just date someone else. But Im looking for something. It has to be out there. I cant be the only person that wants to care, that wants to grow. That doesnt want to keep getting hurt over and over again. I cant be the only person that wants to make art that wants to explore the world around them. Im not and I know that, I met someone else. And Iv enever met anyone else like them since. Im dumb enough I can fall for anything though. Im traumatised so I look for the traumatised. Misery loves its company. I dont want to be like that anymore. I want to heal. I want to not make anyone suffer because of my delusions. And so far ive done a pretty good job of that being by myself. I havent felt near as hurt and I havent felt like Ive had to hurt others. Ive had stressful situations come up with friends and have been able to work through them I hop e to find clarity eventually. I hope that one day I can have a thought and see it to the end instead of just rambling on for pages at a time. One day. One day I will be able to actually feel my emotions for what they are instead of making us so maky stories and inflating my own ego in an attempt to understand them. But not today. Today im telling myself the story that I am someone that lost someone else. Im telling myself the story that Im someone that is hungry and tired. Im telling myself the story that im someone who needs more than what he has. Im tellingmyself the story that im someone that is broken and has done wrong. But none of these stories are entirely true. They are stories. None of them are the nuanced and complex reality of the situations and experiences that I find myself in. There is a different storty that I can tap into. One of abundance. One of forgiveness. One of compassion for myself as well as others. One of healing and growth. I spend a lot of my time focusing on the decay and distruction of the material and emotions around me. Instead of focusing on the quality of those experiences themselves as the are naturally decomposing. I get so caught up on the loss that I cant acknowledge the love that allowed that loss to even be possible. Somedays I can see it. Other days i feel separate, alone , and lost in the woods. Everyone has to go into the woods. The woods are what connect and intertwine out stories as humans. Thats the common ground of really putting the blade to the grindstone and walking into the unknown. Being met with experiences out of your control and learning to grow and overcome the challenges you are faced with. I find myself constantly caught up in this myth of self improvement. And while I think that growth is something that should be strived for im finding that when I put such focus on changing myself in order to better fit the world around me that im only causing myself to feel broken and isolated more and more.Spontanious activity like writing, singing, playing guitar, or making art seems to help break me out of the cycle of worrying about how much im producing. A storm comes through and blows me astray. Narrowly avoiding death. A time of judgement. A call and a response. A sudden acceptance. A wake up call. To be given another chance again. Washed a new. A time to rest and heal from long formed wounds. A miracle, a tragedy. A terrifying offer. A knowledge that it will pass. The chance to actually accept things for what they are. A storm is just a storm. It will pass.
A second chance. A baptism. A moment to accept the whole. A moment to be okay with the pain. You are still here. My own mind scares me some times. I want to live. I want to do all these things. I want to heal. I want to accept myself. I have to accept that a part of myself hates myself. And thats fucked. Sometimes you tell yourself to give up. Sometimes you will find one negative though and expand it for hours. Wallowing in the misery looking for some final moment. Some reason for your rage. You dont have to do this. You do have control and thats one of the hardest things to accept. I dont know why. You can be mindful of yourself. You can notice you are feeding this festering wound. Your picking at the scab. You can choose not to feed it. You can choose to eat something healthy instead of eating fast food. You can choose to drink water instead of soda. You can choose not to masturbate. You can choose not to play video games. You can choose not to stay up until 3. You can choose to read a book instead of playing on your phone. You can choose to play music if your sad instead of thinking about it all day. You can choose to write when you have something to say.

text:
Why is Sisyphus happy
My formula for greatness -that one wants nothing to be different, not forward, not backwards, not in all eternity - not merely bear what is necessary but love it. - Nietzsche
You are not learning helplessness. You are forgetting you have control over your life
Accept the thought with open arms and offer it a cup of tea
Self as Context, the observer
Opposed to
Self as Content, the role
I failed does not mean I am a failure
If I try to grasp this self of which I am assured, if I try to define it and to sum it up, it is no more than a liquid that flows between my fingers. I can depict one by one all the faces that it can assume... This same heart which is mine will ever remain for me undefinable... Always shall I be a stranger to myself -Camus
We suffer because we have identified fully with something that has no purpose. We care more about who we are than what we do. What if we don't need to know who we are to be happy.
Let's accept first that we will never fully know who we are.
We are accepting things in order to reclaim agency over our lives
Once we have accepted what is, we can better decide what we want things to be on our own terms. We can more clearly see what we value.
This does NOT mean we have to accept how things WILL be islf we can see a way to change them.
What can I do next
Autotelic personality, someone that does things for their own sake rather than to achieve some later goal. They are willing to invest more attention in things for their own sake without expecting an immediate return.
We don't need to develope a perfect goal or have absolute freedom to know our next move.
A mountain climber sets as her goal to reach the summit not because she has some deep desire to reach it, but because the goal makes the experience of climbing possible. If it were not for the summit, the climb would become pointless ambling that leaves one restless and apathetic.
What is the next action
Accomplishing any task will not complete us, or make us eternally happy but that is simply because there is nothing to complete. We simply are and will continue to be until our time is up.
What will you do with this time?
Camus imagines Sisyphus as surmounting and possible despair. Sisyphus has broken the shackles of his helplessness and has taken control over his life. He can now decide that yes the absurd holds no promises or certainties, but it also still offers objects for love. Nature, art, other living being, the endless mystery of who we are.
Sisyphus upon acceptance of his situation comits himself to the beauty of life through the arduous task of happiness
Why should he be happy?
We owe it to the good in ourselves and the world to be happy
Happiness is not something that happens or something we get. Rather it is a will towards happiness.
We owe it to ourselves and the world to be happy because there is good in the worlds and the meer presence of it justifies our existence.
When we are stripped down to a certain point, nothing leads anywhere anymore, hope and despair are equally groundless, and the whole of life can be summed up in one image
How can I be a vehicle for purpose or healing
The biggest thing you can do is yluse your voice
Acting come.only come.from the heart

text:
When we get addicted to something the addiction creates a desperation to fix.
So the goal becomes how can I fix it permanently
The moment we let the desperation fuel our desire to overcome an addiction is the moment we lose to the addiction.
Because if it's being fueled by the desperation your setting up fuel that will run out
Your vices are being used as emotional regulation techniques
If you want to quit due to feeling desperate you are doomed to fail
How do you stop forever?
You cant
You can only stop today
The way to quit permanently is by letting go of the word permanently
You can be sober today
You can resist now
If you really want to conquer this stop thinking about tomorrow, stop thinking about the time you've wasted, stop thinking about how important it is you quit.
None of these thoughts are helpful.
They are harmful
Regret about the past, fear of the future, desperation for change
All negative emotions
Instead
One simple thing
Dont smoke today
Dont watch porn now
At this moment in time, don't get high
You can deal with tomorrow when tomorrow comes
But not today
Not today
Procrastinate your addiction
Leverage the traits your already good at
Ill smoke tomorrow. Ill get high later.
I dont have time to watch porn
Keep putting it off
Boredom is the main reason you will relapse.
Boredom is a dopamine craving
Keep your days busy
Fill your gaps with something productive
The root of all of these is emotional regulation
As long as you dont have alternate emotional regulation coping skills, you will default back to your addictions
Your learning better techniques. Your learning meditation, journaling, yoga, playing music, drawing, making art. All of these are more positive than getting high or using nicotine
Your an expert at being addicted, your just now learning how to regulate yourself. Its okay to have a hard time. Youll get better at it over time
Bad stuff feels good because of abundance. We werent wired to have constant stronger and stronger stimulus all day.
We have to evolve as a human to survive on our world
Its on us to learn how to self regulate

text: Time to examine this blockage. We always have this feeling of wanting to create. Of wanting to make a story. Like even trying to think of an idea for a story scares you. I always want to make something but I never know where to start. Ill come up with an idea but it will change forms on me so fast and I can never get a grip on it before it slips past. Every time I start on an idea I reach a point where it feels hopeless. I would rather start with a seed and see what it turns into. Thats not bad. Theres nothing wrong with it. Its okay if other people dont understand that form of creating or storytelling. Your doing you and thats what your good at. Dont tell anyone about what your doing until its done. You dont want any unneeded advice or opinions. You know what your doing. I like a few of the ideas ive come up with its just hard to finish them or know where to go with them. I like the idea of creating a short about struggling to start on creating something. The paradox could be the thing in itself that your focusing on. The need to creat ebeing the thing that pushes along the creation. You dont know what form its going to take. You cant picture it in your head visually but you can feel the emotion that you are going after. Just sit with it. Youve only been writing and getting to know yourself for six months not. So I should start where Im at with the desire to express. Thus the loop continues. How do I boi this down into an idea. A story. A quick metaphor that I can express in under a minute.

ITs all the same all the way around. Its all just a mirror reflecting back in on itself. We are here for each other. We were were we needed to be and now we are still where we need to be. And later on in the future we will still be where were needed. I needed you as much as you needed me. Everything you felt I felt. Everything I felth you felt. We can do this. We built up the wall just to hide the fact that we were in it together. Its scary. Its hard. But youve got this. You learned alot. Your you. Your good. Your really good. Even though bad things happen. I feel your heart. Thats what I loved. I could deal with all that other shit just to be in a room with you and hear your heartbeat. Youve been through hell and still care so much. How could I not love that. Im sorry I only wanted you to care about me. I needed to learn how to care about myself. Im getting better at that. We were young. Weve grown a lot since we first started talking. And were still so young. I cant wait to see what you do. I cant wait to see what you make. I cant wait to see how you turn your pain in to compassion. I wish I could tell you I love you in person, but this is the best I can do for now. One day ill be able to say it to you in person again.

name: How do you feel
text:
A large part of this art journey is going to be learning to describe what I feel. Im not so great at this yet. Journaling seems like it has been helping me to be able to convey my thoughts some. But in general I dont feel like I have much of a voice at the moment. It doesnt have to be like that. I can spend all this time learning all these new skills, like drawing, or guitar. But will it really get me anywhere if I dont knwo how to listen to myself and say anything about how I feel. I cant say im all bad at it. Collage has been a decent way for me to express myself for a while not but its getting to the point where I want a new process. I want a new outlet. One that can flow a little more. One thats original to me. I settles with collage because I thought I wouldnt have to draw. But now I see that learning drawing would have helped me express the ideas I want to express so much more. Your an artist, and this is a process. You cant say everything all at once, but you do have things to say. And you do have the means to output creation. I dont want to shy away from myself anymore. I want to use my thought and emotions and really feel them, understand them, learn that they are. And then I want to make something out of them. I want to create the best things that I can. I want people to connect to my art the same way I connect to theirs. I want to make something that can describe a complex feeling and make it click for someone else and feel a little less alone. I can do that. Ive been doing that. I can just get better at it. This is all a process. Create what your called to create.
Theres days that I miss getting excited
Hearing about some new game, tv show, or technology
Thinking that when I got my hands on whatever the thing is
That I would find happyness
That I would find myself
Yet each time just met with a moment of hollow joy
Then back to the yearning
Ive gotten tired of the wanting
The hope for a better situation
The hope for a better future
Opening empty box after empty box
Hoping to find more that myself reflected back in each one
But thats all I found
If nothing really ever gets better that this
Then maybe thats not so bad
No more looking for boxes to open
Everything you need is right here

name: Its a process
text: I havent sat down just to write in a while. I just got back from the Spoken word night at the old jail. I actually really like what they have going on. Theres some really cool artists there. Ive never considered myself good with words at all. But they haave a way of expressing themselves that I would like to be able to do. They are able to turn their thoughts and experiences into something that can be shared instead of just rambling on a page. I cant expect to be able to do that just off the top of my head after just a few months of journaling and really writing for the first time. This will take some time just like everything else. Age doesnt matter and theres no need to compare yourself to other artists. Your doing your own thing still too and its still valid and its still pretty cool. Theres plenty of people that look at what you do the same way that you look at the artists that you view as above you. Its all a process. Its all the same path. Theres no rush to get anywhere. The whole game is just to be as much you as you can be. Your starting to learn who you are. Youve really learned more in the past year than you ever have. You learned a lot during covid too. And you have changed a ton since then. Some days i feel like an empty shell. Like i play the role of an artist but I really know that theres nothing there underneath. I feel like I have to remind myself of who I am each morning when I wake up. Other artists still feel this way too. Everyone is going through it. Your learning to feel yourself. Your learning to accept yourself. Your at the very beginning of this process. Its going to come with some unexpected scenarios. Your doing okay. Your doing you. Noone else can see all the ways that you doubt yourself unless you think thats what you are. People often see you better than you see yourself currently. Your a pretty cool artist. You can still be doing what your doing and want to strive to achieve more. You cant do it all at once though even though you really want to. Your getting better at everything that you are doing though. There is no loss in fully engaging in what you are doing at the moment. Right now that is writing. You have been doing this consistently for a while now. Your starting to see your brain on display and actually observe it and acknowledge it instead of just letting it all slide by. Eventually you want to be able to write stories and poems and maybe books. But thats going to take time and practice. Theres no rush. Youve already taken the hardest step and started on the journey. You made the decision to start writing and now you cant stop. Now that you have decided hat its a thing you do you will never lose what you have already done. Yet it was never really there to begin with. You can sit down and focusing on writing a story at some point. But you cant expect he first thing that you write to be a masterpiece. Writing is a skill like everything else. Its going to take some editing and refining. The performance part is making it look like your coming up with it on the spot. Its all a process. Your doing what you want to do by doing it right now. You can turn this writing into a poem if you wanted to. But you probably wont because you think that you lack the confidence. Your just scared of the feeling of seeing a white page and having to fill it with something. Youll get there with time.

name: Dont forget your an artist
text:
Your freaking out. Why do you only freak out when you are alone in your thoughts. The second another person enters the room your fine. You feel like the struggle is manageable. You should be able to feel like your enough by yourself. But at the same time I dont really know if humans are meant to spend that much time by themselves. Were built to be in a community. Were built to help and support each other. I dont think im meant to stay locked in a room all day and think that my problems will all be fixed. You wake up every day immediately pissed off about the world that your born into. This has been happening for longer than you can remember now. I dont think it has to be that ways but im not sure of the steps to take to lead to a change thats better. I used to sleep better when I had someone here with me. BUt now im by myself again. You belong. You are enough. I hate that I have to keep repeating myself this so often. I wish I could just know it without having to be reminded every 3 seconds. My thoughts just got out of control. I think having a more normal morning routine would help a lot. A good chunk of your freaking out comes from waking up in the same place you did yesterday and feeling like nothing has changed since the day before. Things are changing. Its all change. How could it not. Sometimes it changes for the worse and sometimes it changes for the better but really they are both the same. You just dont like to accept that its all change so youve built up the model that the world stands still unless you act and its torturing you. There are some very real things taht you are stressing about but then you blow them way out of proportion and think that the world is ending and the only way out is to kill yourself. You know that thats not true. Yet it feels that way when your by yourself. You managed to cry for the first time by yourself yesterday. It wasnt for long but its progress. Its better than smashing something or hurting someone with your words. I dont mean to be a jerk to my parents. Its not their fault that they are ignorant. Yet it kind of is. They could have done something at any point to try and better their situation as well. Your still caught between your own desires and the need for support and their desires for you and lack of functional support. I want to just be able to talk to them when Im having a bad day. I need that. I need emotional support. And thats okay. Everyone does. Its crazy that they dont. They cant help it though. Its time for another change. I dont know what form it will take and I dont know where it will be but I know I need a change. I cant keep going like this. I accept whatever is coming. I wish I had some amount of control over it but I really dont. Every action has a reaction. You can control what your action is but you cant really control the reaction. Can you even really control your action. Or is your action just a reaction to other peoples reactions. I want to be able to control it myself but even then I am not isolated from my surroundings. I still can only act within what i have around me. A lot of your pain is coming from you not wanting to feel what you are feeling. Your angry and stressed. But if you let that be. You are hurt and abandoned and unaccepted. You cant receive that from the people you need it from but you can work to give those things to yourself. Its not easy but people say its possible so maybe it is. Maybe I can learn to accept myself. Even though I dont really know what that means. You havent made any art in a few weeks and its bothering yuo. I dont feel capable of doing it right now, and thats okay. You dont have to do it every single day. But I want to do it. It used to help me feel better. I think Im expecting it to make me feel better.
You have help around you. Your an artist. You want to be a full time artist. You have goals and a direction you want to go. There is a way to get your shit together and do what you want to do.
You have build a good portfolio of different work over the last yaer. Youve showed that you can make posters, album covers, promo videos, music visuals, animations, and a ton of unique art pieces that span a range of emotions and themes. You have worked on a really important step in the process of becoming a full time artist. You have made a good amount of connections in your local area, youve gone to all of the local art shows in town and have made a presence for yourself. Youve gone from only having 4 pictures to having your art in multiple stores,  having your art on display in estonia, having framed pictures, having stickers, and buttons, and over 30 different pictures that you have made that you are comfortable with selling. You have gotten new jobs that alling with what you want to do. Your doing okay. You can still work on this. Its not all lost and its not all going to happen at once. Its a process.
You have started to build a decent online following. You have a lot of thoughts about abandoning it but thats probably not the best idea. You have a lot of people online that really care about your work too. You have people online that want to support you as well. Even if the online stuff doesnt get you a lot of money it is worth doing to get exposure and more eyes on your work.
Your going to have to get over yourself at some point and start doing some work that you dont like doing. You pride is not a positive trait. Your pride for what you do leads to you being hungry in a shed. You have skills that people want you for. Your art is your art. It doesnt matter what it is that your making. It matters that you put yourself and your heart and your intention into it. You can make a lot of different things for a lot of different people.
October is coming up soon. You need to start looking for some more markets that you can take part in. Dont be afraid to ask others for help. Every artist is in this together. If they dont want to tell you that is their deal. Its no harm to ask. Your stuff will do really good around the fall croud so you need to prepare.
Also your only 25 its not all so serious. You should be having fun with all of this. You young and still in the process of figuring it all out. Noone expects you to be perfect. Noone expects you do have a ton of money and be fine right now. Your going to struggle. But you should be having fun. Its never going to get better than right now. You have everything you need. You have time. You are free to do what you want.
You can get a budget together and start focusing on saving us some money so you at least have a cusion under you again.its not impossible and you have help. You about to start making some more money here soon. You will have more opportunities opening up. Its only going to be rough for a little bit but you have the capabilities to get out of it and you have the support to help you do it.
You need to be patient. You cant expect it all to happen at once. You can only take it one day at a time. You need to start setting yourself some goals that you can achieve so you dont feel like your just floating. Your ultimate goal is that you want to be a full time artist. You can achieve that, but it will take time. You need to break that up into smaller goals that are easier to manage and you can notice the change happening. For right now you have art crawl coming up. You want some better pictures made for it you want some things that are easier to sell to a broader audience but still meaningful. You want a better display that has more variety. You dont have to be locked into just one medium or form of creation. You can do whatever you want. Its your art.
You want to get a haircut. You need to get a haircut. Thats an easy goal to achieve. You can do that.
You want to travel. You want to go places at least every 4 months. You need to experience new things and have a change of scenery every once in a while
You want to get this window display done for the transom gallery. Your fear is the only thing stopping you from doing that.
You want to get better at guitar and you are getting better at it, but you dont really want to make it your full focus yet.
You want to get better at drawing and you are. But you have to keep doing it and keep challenging yourself. Youve made a lot of drawings in the last year compared to the past though. Your doing fine.
You want to make animations but you need a reason to, I dont know if im quite there yet. Its hard to focus on that at the moment. We can keep that one as a long term goal it will come around eventually.
You can achieve these things. You are achieving these things. Dont lose focus on your goals dont lose focus on your beliefs
Im not to sure what i believe yet. I know I believe that I dont wan tto work a normal job. I know I believe that I want to be an artist. I know I believe that I can be enough. I know I believe that I am enough.
At the same time acknowledge that you are working yourself into a trap. Dont cling to your past achievements or failures. And have no hope of fruition. Your are working under a system that wants to keep you where you are. Hoping it will eventually get better. It is capitalistic. You in a desert and its going to be tempting to try and eat the sand.
Your depressed because your being fed by something outside of yourself. You are dependent on outside influences to make yourself seem real. Your at the point were you cant be fed by it anymore. You have to sit with your suffering. This isnt something you can achieve all in one lifetime. Its always going to be a challenge.
Youve set impossible metrics that you cant meet. Your only as good as you last piece and even then that last piece doesnt exist. Your here now. Dont judge yourself based on others or your past. Your not a failure because you are not meeting an impossible expectation that you have set for yourself.
You are going through a transition. You are presented with a whole new reality that you are woking to integrate with the one you have now. You can make it. You are not defeated It is incredibly unlikely that you will make it but you can. You have to.
You want to be the person that makes the art not just consumes it. You know what your doing.
You can return back to the place where you dont need affirmations from outside influences to feel like your enough. You can do it at any moment. You just have to learn how. Its a practice
If life is meaningless then why cant you do whatever you want to do.
What is there to annihilate
Positivity has to trump negativity

name: Your in a better place
text: Write while you in a better place. Im doing pretty good today. Its been a nice day. Its been a nice last few days after the freakout. Justin came over today he always manages to put my spiritual mind back in track. Im still dealing with grief and thats okay. But im more than that. I can get to a place where I feel okay on my own. I do right now. I might not tomorrow but thats not here yet. Right now im fine. The moments of clarity com eand then they pass again. You have desires still you have people you want to be with. You not sure if you should pursue it but its there. Your okay where you are though. Its a little strange watching all of your friends get into relationships while you try to get away from your. Maybe you shouldnt be running any more. Be open if something happened. You be okay if something doesnt. But theres no reason you should close yourself off from future people because your afraid of being hurt. You cant exist just as an individual. You need the people around you. You have a community. No one person can exist in a bubble. Its okay to need to ask for help. Your learning that. To try and think that you can do all of this by yourself is insane. There is no by yourself. You can be you without the other people around you, you cant be you without the trees around you. Your never truly cut off from your environment. Your not alone. You cant experience anything that someone else cant relate to. At the same time you are your own unique universe and your experiencing things the only way you can. Express yourself fully. You are it. You cant express yourself wrongly. If your angry be angry. If your sad be sad. If your happy be happy. If your creative be creative. You cant express yourself in a wrong way. You are capable of change. You cant change yourself with things outside of yourself though. You need to come to better understand it. There is only inneer work. The inner work naturally becomes the outerwork. There really is no difference. But you are only capable of change from the self. You cant expect a person to change you, or a job to change you, or a check to change you. Your use of drugs only further pushes you from the realisatoins that you need to change yourself. You numb yourself so that you dont feel the feeling you have about your situation and dont do anything about them . You dont need to do that anymore. You are enough. You dont need to fear what you know to be true. You dont want to work in raleigh. Thats okay. You also dont want to suffer financially while you here. Thats also okay. You dont have to be angry that both of those things can be true at the same time. You can do something about it though. You can help yourself in your situation by asking for help from others. Not even material help, help with things like making a budget. Things like emotional help. Even a plate of food. You shouldnt be ashamed for needing help. You want a community around you that helps each other but then you never want to receive that help when you need it because you feel like you are not worthy of it. Thats not true. People care about you no matter how hard that is for you to believe. Its a shame youve felt for so long that you are not worth being cared about. You dont have to though. People want you to be okay. People want you to be happy. People want you to be the best that you can be. Maybe sometimes they want to hurt you but thats rarely the case. Even then their anger toward you is fear of something they dont understand being directed at you. Your okay. You are enough. You are worthy of love from others. You are worthy of the same love you give to others. You can get to a point where you treat yourself with compassion. Youve gotten really good at doing it with other people but still neglect yourself so much. You need compassion. You need attention. That doesnt have to be something that only comes from the outside. This is a process. Its will always change. Theres nothing that you are doing wrong righ tnow but you can get better at caring for yourself. You can offer yourself the same advice you give others. Its hard to do especially if you are coming froma place of disliking yourself. You can get to a place where you see the connection you had with a person for what it is instead of just that pain of the supposed separation. Your catching glimers of it. Moment where you can look back and be thankful for the experience instead of angry and hurt about it. Its teaching you a lot. Mor than you could have wanted to learn.
